description: torch.compile of the pure-tensor V3 width step (models/cky_compile.py). Costs are measured, never excluded from stream/training results.

final_settings.cudagraph_mark_step_begin: called before every compiled search forward
final_settings.graphs_per_process: one graph per (words, width, explore/swap flags); rows symbolic; V3 with grad also compiles a backward graph per width

first_settings_superseded.why_superseded: real training truncates the last micro-batch of every update, so rows change every update and each (rows, words, width) became a new static graph -> Dynamo recompile limit hit at update 6 (Stage E first attempt); non-tree CUDA graphs cannot hold a symbolic rows dim (ConstraintViolationError), hence trees + cudagraph_mark_step_begin

note_first_call: first-call cost depends on the on-disk inductor cache: the first compile arm of each case after a fresh TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR pays the cold cost (~110-205 s on this CPU for all widths); later arms/cases reuse cached Triton kernels (4-60 s).
